title: VooPoo Vinci E80 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Vinci E80 is a high-powered pod vape kit that combines smart features with all-day performance in a compact and intuitive format. Built around the advanced GENE.TT 2.0 chipset, this device offers up to 80W of adjustable output and intelligent wattage detection for a personalised vape experience. The Vinci E80 includes two integrated Vinci E Cartridges: a 0.3ohm pod for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping, and a 0.6ohm pod for restricted direct-lung (RDL) use. Each 2ml pod is pre-installed with a fixed coil and designed to deliver consistent flavour, long lifespan, and clean performance thanks to Voopoo’s leak-resistant Golden Cotton wicking material. These pods are refillable from the top and offer long-lasting use, with each capable of vaporising up to 100ml of e-liquid. With its generous 3000mAh internal battery and USB-C fast charging, the Vinci E80 keeps you going throughout the day. The large 1.47-inch TFT colour screen displays essential information like battery level, puff count, and coil resistance, while two vaping modes—Smart Mode and RBA Mode—allow you to either let the device optimise the output or fine-tune your settings manually. Despite its robust battery, the E80 remains surprisingly lightweight at just 88.8g. A responsive fire button, side airflow adjustment, and multiple safety protections round out a kit that’s ideal for experienced users who want intelligent performance in a streamlined design. We recommend paring the pods in this kit with the following e-liquids: Voopoo Vinci E replacement pod 0.3ohm - Use high VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid Voopoo Vinci E replacement pod 0.6ohm - Use Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen vape liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
